method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Establishes the Appendix 1 scenic areas; a block visible from one is then held to the visual quality objective set for it by the December 7, 2005 order.
sections.gapNote: The inventory screens draw the scenic polygons; the designation adds nothing a rule can test without the VQO, so the gap sits with the VQO order.
proposedFacts: Is the block or its road in, or visible from, a scenic area listed in the 2005 Prince George scenic areas order?

sections.bearsOn: Folds the scenic areas continued under FRPA s. 180 into this GAR order, so in the district's TSA portion they are GAR scenic areas with VQOs rather than pre-2002 areas left to FPPR s. 9.2.
Lists the scenic areas by name, mostly lakes, rivers, highways, trails and mountains (Adrian Lake to Wolverine River).
Leaves scenic areas and VQOs inside TFLs 30 and 53 to the TFL management planning process.
